hypothesis: Non-financial HS300 firms that convert operating cash flow into free cash flow after capital expenditure, scaled by total assets, should have higher future returns because they combine profitability, capital discipline, and lower dependence on external financing.
selection_basis: R22 recorded free-cash-flow data as unavailable. The later R86 annual cash-flow cache now supplies capex for 452 of 459 historical HS300 symbols. A no-forward-return feasibility audit compared two net-investing-cash-flow proxies and two exact capex-based definitions; the exact FCF/assets variant was frozen because it preserves the FCF definition and its maximum mean absolute monthly correlation with existing factors was 0.603257, below the 0.70 gate. Evidence: data/strategies/ai/.iterations/ai_hs300_multi_factor_rank/evidence/r246_data_feasibility.json

factor.interpretation: Higher means more free cash flow generated per unit of total assets.
factor.pit_rule: Use fiscal-year annual reports only. The effective date is max(vendor notice_date + 1 calendar day, statutory reporting deadline + 3 calendar days); if age since the latest annual report exceeds 500 calendar days, the factor is null. No current-value or interim-report backfill.
factor.missing_data_rule: Missing capex, operating cash flow, total assets, or non-positive assets remain null and are never set to zero or replaced by a proxy.
factor.universe: historical HS300 membership excluding banks and non-bank financials using the current industry snapshot

strategies.weight_rationale: The new annual FCF signal receives 45%; the remaining quality and cash weights preserve the same 54.5/45.5 ratio used by prior matched controls.
strategies.matched_requirements: Both strategies use the same non-financial HS300 universe, FCF-factor availability filter, 30-name score limit, top 10 equal-weight positions, 20-day holding period, -20% stop loss, T+1 open execution, and cost model.

execution.cost_stress: 4x and 5x scale all four cost components proportionally

segments.stitching: compound two independently run segment curves; skip the first return of each later segment

factor_ic.method: month-end factor value versus T+1 open to T+21 open forward return within historical non-financial HS300 members; cross-sectional Spearman rank IC

gates.D3: annual-report PIT construction verified; exact capex source used; no current-list or future-report filling
gates.D4: maximum mean absolute monthly rank correlation with the preregistered existing-factor set <= 0.70
gates.I1: discovery mean rank IC >= 0.02 with at least 24 month-end observations
gates.I2: validation mean rank IC >= 0.01 with at least 18 month-end observations and the same positive sign
gates.G2: discovery candidate MDD is no worse than control MDD by more than 5pp
gates.G4: full-sample candidate return > 0 and >= control return
gates.G5: full-sample candidate MDD <= 40% in absolute value and no worse than control by more than 5pp
gates.G6: rolling 1-year positive rate >= 60% and no worse than control by more than 2pp
gates.G7: recent 12-month candidate return > 0 and MDD no worse than control by more than 5pp
gates.G8: full-sample candidate return at 4x cost is positive
gates.G9: full-sample candidate return at 5x cost is positive
gates.C1: at least 30 distinct symbols are traded across the full sample
gates.C2: the largest symbol's share of net P&L is <= 25%
gates.C3: the top three symbols' share of net P&L is <= 55%
gates.C4: the top five symbols' share of net P&L is <= 75%
gates.C5: at least 8 distinct symbols have positive P&L in the validation segment
gates.C6: the largest industry's share of gross profit is <= 45%
gates.C7: the largest single-symbol loss is <= 20% of gross profit in absolute value

decision_rule: All D, I, G and C gates must pass. Any failure means the factor is not accepted and cannot be rescued by changing the formula, annual window, weights, holding period, stop loss, universe, costs or gates after seeing results.
known_limitations: The factor updates annually and can be stale within a fiscal year.
Capex covers cash paid to construct long-term assets but not acquisitions or other investing outflows.
R86 capex coverage is 452/459 historical symbols; seven symbols failed at the vendor endpoint.
Financial values are current snapshots and may contain restatements.
The industry snapshot used to exclude financials is current rather than historical PIT.
Passing these gates would justify further paper-trading validation, not production deployment.
